headline: Piers Morgan says he will sue Earl Spencer over ‘fabricated inaccuracies’

members.title: Piers Morgan says he will sue Earl Spencer over ‘fabricated inaccuracies’
members.lead: Broadcaster refutes memoir claim that he was behind alleged hidden-camera gym photos of Diana, Princess of Wales Piers Morgan has said he will sue Earl Spencer over “fabricated inaccuracies” and “examples of brazen falsity” in his book about the late Diana, Princess of Wales. The earl has made a series of claims in Swan Song: Diana, My Sister – including that King Charles said “we’ll forget her soon enough” after she died, which has prompted a war of words between him and Buckingham Palace. Continue reading...

members.title: Earl Spencer apologises to Piers Morgan over ‘incorrect assumption’
members.lead: Brother of Diana, Princess of Wales, says ‘accuracy is important’ as he responds to broadcaster’s threat to sue over claims made in memoir Earl Spencer has apologised to Piers Morgan for incorrectly claiming in his new book about Diana, Princess of Wales, that the former tabloid editor was behind the publication of intrusive photos of the late royal in the mid-1990s. Morgan had earlier threatened to sue Spencer over “fabricated inaccuracies” and “examples of brazen falsity” in the book, which was published today. Continue reading...
